lines.en: I crawl sideways along the wall.

lines.zh: 一千格内，我都能闻到你。
lines.en: I can smell you from a thousand blocks.
Your footsteps stop, and so do mine.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声停在你身后。

lines.en: I am not fast, but I never lose the way.
Only my outline remains in the fog.
I round the corner and am gone.

lines.zh: 我的影子在地上动了一下。
lines.en: My shadow shifts on the ground.

lines.zh: 我吊在洞顶，一整天没动。
lines.en: I hang from the cave roof and haven't moved all day.

lines.zh: 我把触角伸进风里试了试。
lines.en: I reach my antennae into the wind and test it.

lines.zh: 我沿着雾气最浓的地方走。
lines.en: I walk where the fog is thickest.

lines.zh: 我的复眼把光分成一千块。
lines.en: My compound eyes break the light into a thousand pieces.
I stand motionless in the fog.

lines.zh: 一千格内，你的脚步我都听。
lines.en: Within a thousand blocks, I hear every step.

lines.zh: 一千格内，我都能找到你。
lines.en: Within a thousand blocks, I find you.

lines.zh: 你一动，我的头就偏过去。
lines.en: The moment you move, my head tilts toward you.

lines.zh: 我一点点挪进你的火把圈。
lines.en: I inch into the circle of your torchlight.
My face presses against the edge of the fog.
I watch you through the fog.
My face comes a little closer.

lines.zh: 我的翅膜破了一个洞，还能追。
lines.en: A hole is torn in my wing membrane, but I can still chase.
An arrow in my back and I'm still chasing.

lines.zh: 雷光把我的轮廓照了出来。
lines.en: The lightning flash reveals my outline.

lines.zh: 我这张脸，被火燎掉半边。
lines.en: Fire burned half my face away.

lines.zh: 翅膀落地，我照样往前走。
lines.en: My wing falls away; I keep walking.

lines.zh: 腐化的诱惑在心中燃烧。
你散发出我渴望的味道。
lines.en: You emit the scent I crave.
That smell of carrion — I can't resist.

lines.zh: 你的命运就是我的养料。
我隔着很远就盯上你了。
lines.en: I picked you out from a thousand blocks.

lines.zh: 一千格的仇恨，只锁一个。
这雾里只有我一只，叫也没用。
lines.en: I'm the only one in this fog; calling is pointless.

lines.zh: 我拖走你掉下的那块肉。
lines.en: I drag away the meat you dropped.

lines.zh: 这地方猎物真多，我的雾也浓。
lines.en: So much prey here, and my fog is thick too.

lines.zh: 一千格内，你跑不出我的范围。
lines.en: Within a thousand blocks, you can't escape me.

lines.zh: 你踏出的第一步，我就听见了。
lines.en: I heard your very first step.
Within a thousand blocks, you cannot hide.

lines.zh: 我张开翅，从树上落下来。
lines.en: I spread my wings and drop from the tree.
Every facet of my eyes holds you.

lines.zh: 你藏得再深，雾也会告诉我。
lines.en: Hide as you like — the fog tells me.

lines.zh: 一千格之外，我已经记下你的味道。
lines.en: From a thousand blocks off, I have your scent.
Within a thousand blocks, I know.
You are on my list now.

lines.zh: 我把整个洞穴都翻过了。
lines.en: I've turned over every cave for you.

lines.zh: 我把洞口堵住，慢慢过去。
lines.en: I block the cave mouth and come on slowly.

lines.zh: 我的口器一张一合，滴着液。
lines.en: My mouthparts open and close, dripping.
Time for you to die, prey!

lines.zh: 一千格的仇恨，你躲不掉。
lines.en: A thousand blocks of hate. You cannot hide.

lines.zh: 我的影子把你的灯吃掉一半。
lines.en: My shadow eats half your lamp's light.
I am in no hurry; I just follow.

lines.zh: 一千格外，我就闻到你了。
lines.en: I caught your scent a thousand blocks off.

lines.zh: 你回头的瞬间，我贴到了墙后。
lines.en: The instant you turn, I press myself behind the wall.
My shadow is taller than before.
I drag you into the white fog in one pull.
Venom seeps from the root of my fang.
My teeth come out of the fog first.

lines.zh: 一千格内，你都在我嘴里。
lines.en: Within a thousand blocks, you're mine.
A thousand blocks of chasing, and I am not tired.

lines.zh: 我一米八的个子，走起来没声。
lines.en: At 1.8 blocks tall, I walk silent.
I'm going to bite your throat!
I drag you into the fog!

lines.zh: 一千格内，你跑多快都算慢。
lines.en: Within a thousand blocks, no speed saves you.
My outline shows in the fog first.

lines.zh: 门缝里的雾，是我带来的。
lines.en: The fog in the door gap came with me.

lines.zh: 一千格的仇恨，我慢慢走过来。
lines.en: A thousand blocks of hate; I will walk it slowly.
I come in with the fog under the door.
I arrive, and the lamp dims a notch.
You hear my footsteps far away.
I have stood behind you a long while.
The fog lights up — I'm burning.

lines.zh: 从那么高摔下来，我的腿歪了。
lines.en: Falling from that height has left my leg crooked.
The blast knocks me back a step...

lines.zh: 这身尺寸被法术撑大了。
lines.en: A spell stretched me to this size.

lines.zh: 我隔着整片林子，已经盯上你了。
lines.en: Across the whole woods, I have you marked.
